title: Automotive
description: Traits shared by every widget of anywidget-automotives (API-001, API-002, ROB-001). The common traits of anywidget-instruments are kept; every widget is an indicator.

mode.description: Always "indicator": nothing is meant to be operated while driving (API-002).

max_age.description: Seconds after which a value not updated is shown as stale; 0: never (ROB-001).

_value_seq.description: Counter a host increments on every assignment of value, even an unchanged one, so that max_age counts from the last update rather than the last change (ROB-001). Hosts that set only changes may leave it alone.

hud.description: On a Cluster: the head-up display mode (HUD-001 .. HUD-006). On a widget held by a Cluster: shown in that mode, with the speed (HUD-004).
